scanNote:
WORKBOOK 39-BET. Unit 9 — inuitlar haqidagi matn va jadval.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 11a (6 surat), 11b (17 bo'shliq), 12-mashq (jadvalning 8 katagi + 4 ta T/F), 13-mashq (Gretsiya haqida ikki xatboshi).

11a SURATLAR: 1 chana (sledge), 2 kayak, 3 skidoo, 4 xaski iti, 5 igloo, 6 hunarmandchilik buyumi (tyulen haykalchasi).

⚠ 'SKIDOO' — bu aslida FIRMA nomi (Ski-Doo), lekin qorda yuradigan mototsiklning umumiy nomiga aylanib ketgan. Matnda 'a kind of motorbike on ice' deb izohlangan.

⚠ 11b — 11 TA SO'Z, 17 BO'ShLIQ: kitob 'Some of these are used more than once' deb ogohlantirgan. 'had' 4 marta, 'were' 2 marta, 'was' 2 marta, 'haven't got' 2 marta ishlatiladi.

⚠ MATNNING TUZILIShI — IKKI QISM QARAMA-QARShI:
  'A hundred years ago' → o'tgan zamon (was, had, were, couldn't, didn't have)
  'Today' → hozirgi zamon (isn't, have got, are, can, haven't got)
  ⚠ Ikkinchi xatboshida fe'llar bir xil tartibda takrorlanadi, faqat zamoni boshqa. Bu — mashqning asosiy g'oyasi.

⚠ ATAMA TO'G'RI: matnda 'the Inuit' ishlatilgan — bu xalqning O'Z nomi va bugun ham to'g'ri hisoblanadi.
  ⚠ Diqqat: 'Inuit' so'zi o'zi KO'PLIKDA ('Inuits' xato), birligi — 'an Inuk'. Grammar 42-betda ham shu qayd bor.

⚠ 12-MAShQ JAVOBLARI (F, T, F, T) matndan aniq chiqadi: inuitlar dehqon emas, OVChI edi; uyi yo'q edi, IGLOOda yashardi; meva-sabzavot yo'q edi, chunki daraxt o'smasdi; xaski itlari chana tortardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which picture shows: an igloo? a Husky dog? arts and crafts? a sledge? a kayak? a skidoo?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi rasmda: igloo? Xaski iti? hunarmandchilik buyumlari? chana? kayak? skidoo?
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SO'Z:
  an igloo        = qordan qurilgan uy
  a Husky dog     = xaski iti (chana tortadi)
  arts and crafts = hunarmandchilik (o'yma, haykalcha)
  a sledge        = chana
  a kayak         = kayak (kichkina qayiq)
  a skidoo        = qor mototsikli

Hammasi INUIT (eskimos) xalqining hayoti bilan bog'liq.
Inuitlar — Kanadaning shimolidagi xalq.

DIQQAT — YOZILISHI:
  'a sledge' — britancha;  'a sled' — amerikacha
  'a Husky' — bosh harf bilan (it zoti nomi)
  'a skidoo' — 'Ski-Doo' savdo belgisidan kelib chiqqan

items.textEn: 1  (rasm: odam qor ustida chana tortib turibdi)
items.whyUz:
Chana rasmi → A SLEDGE.
Ilgari inuitlar chanani XASKI itlariga tortdirgan.
Hozir skidoo ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 2  (rasm: odam kichkina qayiqda suvda)
items.whyUz:
Qayiq rasmi → A KAYAK.
Matnda: 'kayaks — small canoes' (kichkina qayiqlar).
Dengizda ov qilish uchun ishlatilgan.
'kayak' so'zi INUIT tilidan ingliz tiliga o'tgan.

items.textEn: 3  (rasm: odam qor mototsiklida)
items.whyUz:
Qor mototsikli rasmi → A SKIDOO.
Matnda: 'a kind of motorbike on ice'.
Hozirgi zamon transporti — chananing o'rnini bosgan.

items.textEn: 4  (rasm: oq-qora yuzli it)
items.whyUz:
It rasmi → A HUSKY DOG.
Matnda: 'Husky dogs to help them pull their sledges'.
Bosh harf bilan — zot nomi.

items.textEn: 5  (rasm: qordan qurilgan gumbaz shaklidagi uy)
items.whyUz:
Qor uy rasmi → AN IGLOO.
Matnda: 'igloos — houses made of ice'.
DIQQAT: 'AN igloo' — 'i' unli tovush.

items.textEn: 6  (rasm: oq tosh/suyakdan yasalgan tyulen haykalchasi)
items.whyUz:
O'yma haykalcha rasmi → ARTS AND CRAFTS.
Matnda bo'sh vaqt mashg'uloti sifatida keladi.
'crafts' = hunarmandchilik; 'arts' = san'at.
DOIM juft holda ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Now read the text about the Inuit and fill in the gaps with: are, have got, can, was, were, had, isn't, haven't got, weren't, couldn't, didn't have. Some of these are used more than once.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi inuitlar haqidagi matnni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni quyidagilar bilan to'ldiring: are, have got, can, was, were, had, isn't, haven't got, weren't, couldn't, didn't have. Ba'zilari bir necha marta ishlatiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A hundred years ago, life WAS very different for the Inuit
  in Canada. In those days, they DIDN'T HAVE houses to live
  in; they HAD igloos — houses made of ice. The Inuit WERE
  hunters of whales and seals. They only HAD meat and fish
  to eat. They COULDN'T eat any fruit or vegetables because
  there WEREN'T any trees or plants. The Inuit HAD Husky
  dogs to help them pull their sledges. They also HAD kayaks
  — small canoes — to help them hunt in the sea. Their
  favourite free-time activities WERE dancing and arts and
  crafts.

  Today, life for the Inuit ISN'T the same as it WAS a
  hundred years ago. They HAVEN'T GOT igloos now. They HAVE
  GOT modern houses and they live in small towns. There ARE
  schools, hospitals, shops and many other modern buildings
  in the towns. These days, the Inuit CAN eat anything they
  like. They HAVEN'T GOT sledges anymore. They travel by
  skidoo — a kind of motorbike on ice. Today, their
  favourite free-time activities are listening to pop music
  and going to the cinema just like most other Canadians.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Yuz yil oldin Kanadadagi inuitlar hayoti juda boshqacha
  edi. O'sha kunlarda ularning yashash uchun uylari yo'q
  edi; iglular — muzdan qurilgan uylar bor edi. Inuitlar
  kit va tyulen ovchilari edi. Ularda faqat go'sht va baliq
  bor edi. Ular meva yoki sabzavot yeya olmasdi, chunki
  daraxt yoki o'simlik yo'q edi. Inuitlarda chana tortishga
  yordam beradigan xaski itlari bor edi. Shuningdek dengizda
  ov qilish uchun kayaklari — kichkina qayiqlari bor edi.
  Sevimli bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari raqs va hunarmandchilik
  edi.
  Bugun inuitlar hayoti yuz yil oldingidek emas. Endi
  ularda iglu yo'q. Zamonaviy uylari bor va kichik
  shaharchalarda yashaydilar. Shaharchalarda maktab,
  kasalxona, do'kon va boshqa ko'p zamonaviy binolar bor.
  Hozirgi kunda inuitlar xohlagan narsasini yeya oladi.
  Endi ularda chana yo'q. Ular skidoo — muz ustidagi
  mototsikl bilan yuradilar. Bugun ularning sevimli bo'sh
  vaqt mashg'ulotlari — pop musiqa tinglash va kinoteatrga
  borish, xuddi boshqa kanadaliklar kabi.

MATN IKKI QISMGA BO'LINGAN:
  1-xatboshi — YUZ YIL OLDIN → hammasi O'TGAN zamonda
  2-xatboshi — BUGUN → hammasi HOZIRGI zamonda

  'Today' so'zi zamonlar chegarasini bildiradi.

QAYSI SO'Z NECHA MARTA:
  had          → 4 marta
  was          → 2 marta
  were         → 2 marta
  haven't got  → 2 marta
  qolganlari   → 1 martadan
  Jami: 17 bo'shliq

items.textEn: 1  A hundred years ago, life ............ very different for the Inuit in Canada.
items.whyUz:
'A hundred years ago' → O'TGAN zamon.
'life' BIRLIK → WAS.
'different' — sifat, shuning uchun 'to be' kerak.

items.textEn: 2  In those days, they ............ houses to live in;
items.hintUz: Keyingi qismga qarang — ular iglularda yashagan
items.whyUz:
MANTIQ: keyin 'they HAD igloos' deyilgan —
demak oddiy UY yo'q edi → INKOR.
O'tgan zamon + mulk inkori → DIDN'T HAVE.
'to live in' = yashash uchun ('in' oxirida qoladi).

items.textEn: 3  ... they ............ igloos — houses made of ice.
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon + mulk → HAD.
'houses made of ice' = muzdan qurilgan uylar.
'made of' = ...dan yasalgan.

items.textEn: 4  The Inuit ............ hunters of whales and seals.
items.hintUz: 'The Inuit' — KO'PLIK (xalq nomi); keyin KASB keladi
items.whyUz:
'hunters' — kasb (ot) → 'to be' kerak.
'The Inuit' — xalq nomi, KO'PLIK → WERE.
'a whale' = kit;  'a seal' = tyulen.
12-mashqning 1-savoli shu bandga asoslanadi.

items.textEn: 5  They only ............ meat and fish to eat.
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon + mulk → HAD.
'only' = faqat — boshqa ovqat yo'q edi.

items.textEn: 6  They ............ eat any fruit or vegetables ...
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L ('eat') → 'could/couldn't'.
'ANY' → INKOR → COULDN'T.
12-mashqning 3-savoli shu bandga asoslanadi.

items.textEn: 7  ... because there ............ any trees or plants.
items.whyUz:
'ANY' → INKOR.
'trees or plants' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.
'because' sababni tushuntiradi: daraxt yo'q → meva yo'q.

items.textEn: 8  The Inuit ............ Husky dogs to help them pull their sledges.
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon + mulk → HAD.
'to pull' = tortmoq.
12-mashqning 4-savoli shu bandga asoslanadi.

items.textEn: 9  They also ............ kayaks — small canoes — to help them hunt in the sea.
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon + mulk → HAD.
'a canoe' = qayiq.
'to hunt' = ov qilmoq.

items.textEn: 10  Their favourite free-time activities ............ dancing and arts and crafts.
items.whyUz:
'activities' KO'PLIK → WERE.
'free-time activities' = bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari.

items.textEn: 11  Today, life for the Inuit ............ the same as ...
items.whyUz:
'Today' → HOZIRGI zamonga o'tildi.
'life' BIRLIK → is/isn't.
MANTIQ: hayot O'ZGARGAN → 'the same as' oldidan INKOR →
ISN'T.
'the same AS' = ...bilan bir xil ('the same like' XATO).

items.textEn: 12  ... as it ............ a hundred years ago.
items.whyUz:
'a hundred years ago' → O'TGAN zamon.
'it' BIRLIK → WAS.
Bitta gapda ikki zamon: ISN'T (hozir) ... WAS (o'shanda).

items.textEn: 13  They ............ igloos now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
MANTIQ: keyin 'they HAVE GOT modern houses' deyilgan —
demak iglu YO'Q → INKOR → HAVEN'T GOT.
'They' KO'PLIK → haven't ('hasn't' EMAS).

items.textEn: 14  They ............ modern houses and they live in small towns.
items.whyUz:
'They' → HAVE GOT.
2-band bilan solishtiring: ilgari uy yo'q edi, hozir bor.

items.textEn: 15  There ............ schools, hospitals, shops and many other modern buildings in the towns.
items.whyUz: Hozirgi zamon + KO'PLIK otlar → THERE ARE.

items.textEn: 16  These days, the Inuit ............ eat anything they like.
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L → 'can/could'.
'These days' = hozirgi kunda → HOZIRGI → CAN.
6-band bilan solishtiring: ilgari COULDN'T edi.
'anything they like' = xohlagan narsasi.

items.textEn: 17  They ............ sledges anymore.
items.whyUz:
'ANYMORE' = endi (DOIM inkor bilan) → HAVEN'T GOT.
'They' KO'PLIK → haven't.
Keyingi gap tushuntiradi: 'They travel by skidoo'.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL — THE INUIT:

  ┌───────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
  │               │ THEN             │ NOW              │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Houses        │ igloos — houses  │ modern houses    │
  │               │ made of ice      │ (KITOBDA BOR)    │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Food          │ meat and fish    │ anything they    │
  │               │ (KITOBDA BOR)    │ like             │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Travel        │ sledges, kayaks  │ skidoos          │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Entertainment │ dancing,         │ listening to pop │
  │               │ arts and crafts  │ music, going to  │
  │               │ (2-si KITOBDA)   │ the cinema       │
  └───────────────┴──────────────────┴──────────────────┘

Hamma ma'lumot 11b-matnda bor —
faqat to'g'ri joyni topish kerak.

Kitob 3 ta katakni ALLAQACHON to'ldirgan:
  Houses / NOW      → modern houses
  Food / THEN       → meat and fish
  Entertainment / THEN (2-qism) → arts and crafts
va 'Travel / THEN' katagida 'sledges,' so'zini bergan.

items.textEn: Houses — THEN
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'they had IGLOOS — HOUSES MADE OF ICE'.
Jadvalda ikki qator bor — shuning uchun to'liq ibora yoziladi.

items.textEn: Houses — NOW
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'They have got MODERN HOUSES'.
Kitob bu katakni to'ldirib bergan.

items.textEn: Food — THEN
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They only had MEAT AND FISH to eat'.

items.textEn: Food — NOW
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'the Inuit can eat ANYTHING THEY LIKE'.
Ilgari faqat go'sht va baliq — hozir hamma narsa.

items.textEn: Travel — THEN  (sledges, ............)
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'They also had KAYAKS — small canoes'.
Jadvalda 'sledges,' allaqachon yozilgan → ikkinchisi KAYAKS.

items.textEn: Travel — NOW
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'They travel by SKIDOO — a kind of motorbike on ice'.
Jadvalda ko'plikda yoziladi: SKIDOOS.

items.textEn: Entertainment — THEN  (............ , arts and crafts)
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'their favourite free-time activities were DANCING
and arts and crafts'.
'arts and crafts' kitobda berilgan → birinchisi DANCING.

items.textEn: Entertainment — NOW
items.answer: listening to pop music, going to the cinema
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'their favourite free-time activities are
LISTENING TO POP MUSIC and GOING TO THE CINEMA'.
Ikkalasi ham -ing shaklida (mashg'ulot nomi).

exercises.instructionEn: Mark the statements that follow as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapning javobi 11b-matnda BOR.
Matndagi aynan shu joyni toping va solishtiring.

DIQQAT: gaplar YUZ YIL OLDINGI hayot haqida
(hammasi o'tgan zamonda).

items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI.
Matnda: 'The Inuit were HUNTERS of whales and seals'.
'a hunter' = ovchi;  'a farmer' = dehqon, fermer.
Inuitlar dehqonchilik qila olmasdi — daraxt va o'simlik yo'q edi.

items.sentence: 2  They didn't have houses to live in.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI.
Matnda AYNAN shunday yozilgan: 'they didn't have houses
to live in; they had igloos'.
Iglu — oddiy uy emas, muzdan qurilgan boshpana.

items.sentence: 3  They had lots of fruit and vegetables to eat.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI.
Matnda: 'They COULDN'T eat any fruit or vegetables because
there weren't any trees or plants'.
Aynan TESKARISI aytilgan.

items.sentence: 4  They had Husky dogs to help them.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI.
Matnda: 'The Inuit had HUSKY DOGS to help them pull their
sledges'.

sections.title: Writing — Ancient Greece and Modern Greece
sections.titleUz: Yozuv — Qadimgi Gretsiya va Zamonaviy Gretsiya

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the chart to write about life in Ancient Greece and life in Modern Greece. Write two separate paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Qadimgi Gretsiya va Zamonaviy Gretsiyadagi hayot haqida yozing. Ikkita alohida xatboshi yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:

  ┌───────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
  │               │ ANCIENT GREECE   │ MODERN GREECE    │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Houses        │ small houses     │ blocks of flats, │
  │               │ with small       │ villas, glass    │
  │               │ windows and two  │ office blocks    │
  │               │ or three rooms   │                  │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Food          │ meat, fish,      │ anything they    │
  │               │ fruit,           │ like             │
  │               │ vegetables,      │                  │
  │               │ olives           │                  │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Travel        │ horses, ships    │ cars, ships,     │
  │               │ to sail the seas │ trains,          │
  │               │                  │ aeroplanes       │
  ├───────────────┼──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
  │ Entertainment │ hunting,         │ dancing, going   │
  │               │ horseback riding │ to the cinema/   │
  │               │                  │ theatre,         │
  │               │                  │ watching TV      │
  └───────────────┴──────────────────┴──────────────────┘

IKKI XATBOSHI:
  1-xatboshi — QADIMGI Gretsiya → hammasi O'TGAN zamonda
     had, didn't have, there was/were, could
  2-xatboshi — ZAMONAVIY Gretsiya → hammasi HOZIRGI zamonda
     have got, there is/are, can

11b-matndagi Inuitlar haqidagi matnni NAMUNA qilib oling —
u ham aynan shu tuzilishda yozilgan.

TO'LIQ NAMUNA MATN:

  In Ancient Greece, people had small houses with small
  windows and two or three rooms. They had meat, fish,
  fruit, vegetables and olives to eat. They travelled by
  horse and they had ships to sail the seas. Their favourite
  free-time activities were hunting and horseback riding.

  Today, life in Greece is very different. People have got
  blocks of flats and villas, and there are glass office
  blocks in the cities. They can eat anything they like.
  They travel by car, ship, train or aeroplane. Their
  favourite free-time activities are dancing, going to the
  cinema or the theatre and watching TV.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Qadimgi Gretsiyada odamlarning kichik derazali, ikki-uch
  xonali kichik uylari bor edi. Yeyish uchun go'sht, baliq,
  meva, sabzavot va zaytun bor edi. Ular ot bilan yurishardi
  va dengizlarda suzish uchun kemalari bor edi. Sevimli
  bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari ov qilish va ot minish edi.
  Bugun Gretsiyadagi hayot juda boshqacha. Odamlarning
  ko'p qavatli uylari va villalari bor, shaharlarda shisha
  ofis binolari bor. Ular xohlagan narsasini yeya oladilar.
  Mashina, kema, poyezd yoki samolyotda yuradilar. Sevimli
  bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari — raqs, kinoteatr yoki teatrga
  borish va televizor ko'rish.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an olive        = zaytun
  a block of flats = ko'p qavatli turar joy binosi
  a villa         = villa, hovli-uy
  an office block = ofis binosi
  to sail         = suzmoq (kema bilan)
  horseback riding = ot minish
  an aeroplane    = samolyot (amerikacha: airplane)

structure.heading: Para 1 — Houses (Ancient Greece)
structure.guideUz:
O'TGAN zamon: 'people HAD ...'.
'with' bilan tavsif qo'shiladi.
structure.modelEn: In Ancient Greece, people had small houses with small windows and two or three rooms.

structure.heading: Para 1 — Food (Ancient Greece)
structure.guideUz:
'They had ... to eat.' qolipi — 11b-matndagidek.
Beshta narsa 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.
structure.modelEn: They had meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and olives to eat.

structure.heading: Para 1 — Travel (Ancient Greece)
structure.guideUz:
'They travelled by ...' yoki 'They had ...'.
'to sail the seas' = dengizlarda suzish uchun.
structure.modelEn: They travelled by horse and they had ships to sail the seas.

structure.heading: Para 1 — Entertainment (Ancient Greece)
structure.guideUz:
'Their favourite free-time activities WERE ...'.
Mashg'ulotlar -ing shaklida.
structure.modelEn: Their favourite free-time activities were hunting and horseback riding.

structure.heading: Para 2 — Houses (Modern Greece)
structure.guideUz:
HOZIRGI zamon: 'people HAVE GOT ...', 'there ARE ...'.
Avval o'zgarishni e'lon qiling.
structure.modelEn: Today, life in Greece is very different. People have got blocks of flats and villas, and there are glass office blocks in the cities.

structure.heading: Para 2 — Food (Modern Greece)
structure.guideUz:
'They CAN eat anything they like.' —
11b-matndagi 16-band bilan bir xil qolip.
structure.modelEn: They can eat anything they like.

structure.heading: Para 2 — Travel (Modern Greece)
structure.guideUz: 'They travel BY ...' — transport oldidan artikl YO'Q.
structure.modelEn: They travel by car, ship, train or aeroplane.

structure.heading: Para 2 — Entertainment (Modern Greece)
structure.guideUz:
'Their favourite free-time activities ARE ...'.
1-xatboshi bilan solishtiring: u yerda WERE edi.
structure.modelEn: Their favourite free-time activities are dancing, going to the cinema or the theatre and watching TV.

wordFormation.introUz: 39-bet — Inuitlar lug'ati, Gretsiya lug'ati, o'tgan ↔ hozirgi zamon almashinuvi.

groups.explanationUz: Ba'zi so'zlar inuit tilidan ingliz tiliga o'tgan.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 39-betdagi asosiy qoliplar — 'then and now' matni yozish uchun.

patterns.formula: A hundred years ago, life WAS very different for ... .
patterns.exampleEn: A hundred years ago, life was very different for the Inuit in Canada.
patterns.exampleUz: Yuz yil oldin Kanadadagi inuitlar hayoti juda boshqacha edi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'then and now' matnining tayyor KIRISH gapi.

patterns.formula: They HAD ... .  They DIDN'T HAVE ... .  They COULDN'T ... .
patterns.exampleEn: They had igloos. They didn't have houses to live in. They couldn't eat any fruit.
patterns.exampleUz: Iglulari bor edi. Yashash uchun uylari yo'q edi. Meva yeya olmasdi.
patterns.explanationUz: O'TGAN qism uchun uchta asosiy qolip.

patterns.formula: Today, life ... ISN'T the same as it WAS ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Today, life for the Inuit isn't the same as it was a hundred years ago.
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun inuitlar hayoti yuz yil oldingidek emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
O'tgan qismdan hozirgi qismga O'TISH gapi.
Bitta gapda ikki zamon: ISN'T (hozir) ... WAS (o'shanda).
'the same AS' — 'as' shart.

patterns.formula: They HAVE GOT ... .  There ARE ... .  They CAN ... .
patterns.exampleEn: They have got modern houses. There are schools and hospitals. They can eat anything they like.
patterns.exampleUz: Zamonaviy uylari bor. Maktab va kasalxonalar bor. Xohlagan narsasini yeya oladilar.
patterns.explanationUz: HOZIRGI qism uchun uchta asosiy qolip.

patterns.formula: They HAVEN'T GOT ... ANYMORE.  They travel BY ... .
patterns.exampleEn: They haven't got sledges anymore. They travel by skidoo.
patterns.exampleUz: Endi ularda chana yo'q. Ular skidoo bilan yuradilar.
patterns.explanationUz:
'anymore' DOIM inkor bilan, gap oxirida.
Transport oldidan BY + artiklsiz.

patterns.formula: Their favourite free-time activities WERE/ARE + -ing shakllari.
patterns.exampleEn: Their favourite free-time activities were dancing and arts and crafts.
patterns.exampleUz: Sevimli bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari raqs va hunarmandchilik edi.
